trickyParts: api.State's Issue view carries no tree: an issue's tree is recorded on its claims (OperatorClaim.tree, `legion claims list --json`), which is where a proof reads it

The sweep's delete fence: since ensureSandbox relabels a suspended Sandbox in place (same UID), only {UID, ResourceVersion} tells a re-admitted issue's Sandbox from the orphan the informer snapshot saw
A gone-wait in bash: `[ -z "$(cmd)" ]` discards cmd's status; `out=$(cmd) && [ -z "$out" ]` is what every such wait uses
The production floor is memory-bound (instance-memory Gt 65535), so the smallest allowed type is an 8-vCPU/64 GiB node and a 3 CPU / 12 GiB pod fits two per node, cpu binding
gVisor exposes no cgroup files: the in-pod checks are nproc == max(2, ceil(sum cpu limits)) and MemTotal within 3% of the summed memory limits — confirmed live by stage 4a `resources`
